// About: Recordings the engine is known not to reproduce yet (id or prefix* -> reason). tests/conformance/engine.test.ts tolerates them and prints the ones that pass again: remove those. Charts that use a construct whose transformation is not implemented are skipped automatically (the engine reports code 'unsupported'), so they need no entry here.
kieler-probes/structure/probe-reference-: KIELER crashes in StructuralDepthJoinProcessor.isInSurface when it cures the schizophrenic fork around a referenced chart whose re-entered superstate holds a state without node (S-15a); the engine does not model that cure's surface search yet and accepts the chart. Found by the schedules fuzz profile (seed 5).
kieler-probes/structure/probe-method-if-: KIELER's scoping puts the condition of an `if` in a method body inside the scope of the branch's declarations: `if (N > 4) { int N = 1 ... }` reads the branch's own N (0 before its initialisation) and takes the else branch, while the engine's name resolution (parser/resolve.ts) gives the condition the chart's N. Found while porting the block scoping of the replacement walk (structure.md S-74); with a value bound to the name both reject (KIELER's ClassCastException).
kieler-probes/codegen/probe-array-compar: Two whole arrays compared with == or != are two addresses in KIELER's C code (`d->a == d->b`, false for two arrays), the engine compares them as values. Found with the array-as-value check (a whole array assigned to a number is rejected; a comparison is legal C).
